  1. Hugging Face

Hugging Face

How to pull models from Hugging Face, including public, gated, and private repositories.

The hf:// URI 

models:
  - name: sentiment
    runtime: kserve-huggingfaceserver
    modelFormat: huggingface
    storageUri: hf://distilbert/distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english

The format is hf://{organization}/{repository}. The storage initializer downloads the repository and mounts it at /mnt/models before the runtime starts.

Pin a revision when the runtime supports it:

    storageUri: hf://meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct:refs%2Fpr%2F1

Public models need no token. Configure credentials only for gated or private repositories, or to avoid anonymous rate limits.

Token configuration

Chart-managed Secret

The chart creates the Secret from the token you supply.

hfSecret:
  enabled: true
  managed: true
  name: hf-secret
  token: "hf_replace_me"

Never commit the token. Pass it at install time:

helm upgrade --install model-serving helm-charts/model-serving \
  --namespace kserve \
  -f values.yaml \
  --set-string hfSecret.token="$HF_TOKEN"

Or keep it in a separate, protected file:

helm upgrade --install model-serving helm-charts/model-serving \
  --namespace kserve -f values.yaml -f secrets.yaml

Externally managed Secret

Preferred with sealed secrets, External Secrets Operator, or Vault. The chart injects the reference but does not create the Secret.

hfSecret:
  enabled: true
  managed: false
  name: hf-secret

Create the Secret in the workload namespace, with the key HF_TOKEN:

kubectl create secret generic hf-secret \
  --namespace models \
  --from-literal=HF_TOKEN="$HF_TOKEN"

The key must be exactly HF_TOKEN. A Secret with a different key renders successfully but the pod fails to start with a missing key error.

How the token reaches the pod

When hfSecret.enabled is true, the chart adds this to each generated models entry and to the leader and worker containers of llmInferenceServices:

env:
  - name: HF_TOKEN
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: hf-secret
        key: HF_TOKEN

Opt out for a specific workload:

models:
  - name: public-model
    storageUri: hf://sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
    injectHfToken: false

Prefill pools receive the token on the same terms as the leader. Disable it for the prefill pool alone:

llmInferenceServices:
  - name: llama-disagg
    model:
      uri: hf://meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
    prefill:
      replicas: 2
      injectHfToken: false

Supplying containers explicitly under template, worker, or prefill.template replaces the generated container, so that pool receives only the env you define there.

Gated models

Models such as Llama and Gemma require accepting a license first.

  1. Sign in to Hugging Face and open the model page.
  2. Accept the license and wait for approval.
  3. Create a token with read access at https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens.
  4. Confirm the token can see the repository:
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $HF_TOKEN" \
  https://huggingface.co/api/models/meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct | head

A 401 or 403 means the token lacks access; the download will fail the same way inside the cluster.

Private repositories

Private repositories use the same token mechanism. Ensure the token belongs to a user or organization with access:

hfSecret:
  enabled: true
  managed: false
  name: hf-secret

models:
  - name: internal-model
    runtime: kserve-huggingfaceserver
    modelFormat: huggingface
    storageUri: hf://my-org/internal-classifier

Multiple tokens

The chart injects a single Secret reference. For workloads needing different tokens, disable injection and set the variable explicitly.

hfSecret:
  enabled: true
  managed: false
  name: hf-secret

models:
  - name: team-a-model
    storageUri: hf://team-a/model
    injectHfToken: false
    env:
      - name: HF_TOKEN
        valueFrom:
          secretKeyRef:
            name: team-a-hf-token
            key: HF_TOKEN

Offline and mirrored environments

Point the client at an internal mirror:

models:
  - name: mirrored-model
    runtime: kserve-huggingfaceserver
    modelFormat: huggingface
    storageUri: hf://my-org/model
    env:
      - name: HF_ENDPOINT
        value: https://hf-mirror.internal.example.com

Prevent any network call once the artifact is mounted:

    env:
      - name: TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE
        value: "1"
      - name: HF_HUB_OFFLINE
        value: "1"

For clusters with no internet access, copy models to object storage and use s3://. See S3 and air-gapped.

Reducing repeated downloads

Every pod restart re-downloads the model unless it is cached. Options:

  • Enable node-local caching. See Local model cache.
  • Copy the model into a PVC and use pvc://. See Storage URIs.
  • Mirror the model into object storage close to the cluster.

Troubleshooting

Symptom Cause Fix
401 Unauthorized Missing or invalid token Verify the Secret exists in the workload namespace with key HF_TOKEN
403 Forbidden Gated license not accepted Accept the license with the account owning the token
404 Not Found Wrong repository name or private without access Check the hf://org/repo path
Pod stuck Init:0/1 Download still running Watch kubectl logs <pod> -c storage-initializer -n models
CreateContainerConfigError Secret or key missing kubectl get secret hf-secret -n models -o jsonpath='{.data}'

Inspect the download directly:

kubectl logs -n models <pod-name> -c storage-initializer
